Description.SourceString:
The dwarven smith is taunting us, Sir, and it cannot be allowed to continue. Not only has he claimed the penguin disguise, but he was seen WEARING it to a party. It is an insult beyond comprehension. Imagining his squat gingery legs stepping into our elegant form is enough to make me cough up dry bones.

Now, if it were the legs of that tall human with the sword? That, I think you would agree, could be forgiven, Sir.
